title: catha edulis
intro: Catha edulis, commonly known as Khat or Kat, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing stress, anxiety, and fatigue, as well as improving mental clarity and focus. The therapeutic actions of Catha edulis include stimulating the nervous system, increasing alertness, and enhancing mood, although its long-term use can lead to dependence and addiction. The bioactive constituents of Catha edulis include cathinone, cathine, and norephedrine, which are responsible for its psychoactive and stimulant properties.
